title: Aureline M5 stack-edit disposition
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for the disposition of one proposed stack edit (reorder, split, squash, or restack) whose review sheet has been shown but not yet applied. It keeps the explicit continue / abort / export / defer paths available so a proposed re-stack plan is never lost when a provider write, a hosted approval, a local validation, or a policy boundary goes stale or blocks publish. Names the object class, its change-orchestration association, the stack-edit operation under review, the source of the staleness that gates a continue, the currently offered dispositions, the resolved disposition state, and whether the proposed plan stays preserved for retry or export — so a local-only continue is never shown as a provider-committed landing, no stack member is silently reordered or retargeted, and nothing lands from ambient branch state. Downstream the stack-edit / review sheet, patch-stack / queue, provider-landing, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating disposition behavior by hand. Raw paths, raw provider payloads, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
